basic_info.description:
Welcome to 1059 Alabama Street, a beautifully renovated 1,130-square-foot Victorian condo that artfully blends San Francisco's timeless charm with modern elegance. Nestled in the heart of Potrero Hill, this two-bedroom, one-bathroom plus Loft gem offers an exceptional layout and abundant natural light throughout. You'll be greeted by a spacious open-concept living area featuring spectacularly high ceilings and a stunning skylight, which floods the room with light, creating a warm and airy ambiance. The main level boasts two bedrooms and a full bathroom on one side. In contrast, the other side is a beautifully integrated space combining the living room, dining area, and kitchen, ideal for entertaining and daily living.
Adding to the condo's unique character, the third bedroom is perched atop the kitchen on the third floor, accessible via a custom library-style staircase. Another skylight offers sweeping views of Sutro Tower and San Francisco's lush greenery, making this space both private and enchanting. A private backyard oasis from the main living area offers a peaceful retreat from city life. With the convenience of underground parking and ample storage, this home truly captures the essence of Potrero Hills' vibrant lifestyle.
